# Radoslav Radev Advises Never Going To Failure In Every Single Workout

Radoslav Radev gives as his rule number three: never go to a failure every single workout. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 03:50]

## Details

- He calls going to failure every single workout really wrong. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 03:50]

## Evidence

- vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 03:50 (Radoslav Radev): "rule number three never go to a failure every single workout"
- vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 04:01 (Radoslav Radev): "what happens every workout the nervous system getting more and more tired the next workout even more tired and slowly they start losing progress"

## Why This Matters

He says that when people push to the limit every session, the nervous system gets more and more tired and they slowly start losing progress. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 04:01]

## Connected Ideas

- [[Radoslav Radev Recommends Pushing To The Limit In Maximum Two Of Four Workouts Per Week, With The Other Two At 50 To 70 Percent Effort]] — his suggested weekly structure.
